Adani Ports wins bid for two dry bulk berths at Paradip Port

Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ) has emerged as the highest bidder for two dry bulk cargo berths at Paradip Port in Odisha. This acquisition is expected to add 18 million metric tons (MMT) of capacity to the port's East Coast network. The company's stock saw an increase following the announcement of the project win.
